HelpDetails.MarkPaidTitle: When to use Mark as paid
HelpDetails.MarkPaidBody: Use it after checking that the document represents a payment and you know the payment date, method and amount. It suits a receipt or bill that is not already recorded as a transaction.
HelpDetails.MarkPaidEffect: TaxVault opens a confirmation form. Check the suggested date and amount, choose the payment method, then confirm. The document changes to Paid and shows the payment details. TaxVault also creates one linked, uncategorised expense for you to review in Income & expenses.
HelpDetails.MarkPaidUnavailableTitle: When Mark as paid is unavailable
HelpDetails.MarkPaidUnavailableBody: Assign a financial year first. If the document contains multiple or mixed transactions, use Income & expenses so each transaction can be checked separately. Do not mark a year-to-date or statement total as one payment.
HelpDetails.DeleteDocumentBody: Delete is permanent and requires confirmation. It removes the original file, document entry and review items. Existing OCR extraction, evidence and transactions remain, but are detached from the deleted source document. This cannot be undone.
HelpDetails.DeleteDocumentBefore: Before deleting, confirm that the file is a duplicate or was uploaded by mistake. If it is still processing, wait for extraction to finish. If you only want to change its description, use Edit description instead.

HelpReview.Step1Body: Open Reviews and set the correct financial year. Use Status for pending items and Type to narrow the list. Each card shows the document, extracted-field count and low-confidence values.
HelpReview.Step2Body: Open Source document, then preview it in TaxVault or download the original. Check the complete page, not only the text OCR found.
HelpReview.Step3Body: In Document Extraction, compare every OCR value with the source. Confidence is a warning signal, not proof; low confidence means look closely.
HelpReview.Step4Body: If OCR missed a value, use Add missing details. If it is wrong, use Correct this value and Save Correction. The correction keeps the original OCR result traceable.
HelpReview.Step5Body: Add notes, then Approve or Reject. If the document should create records, enable Also save transactions in Income & expenses and enter each payment as its own income or expense.
HelpReview.Step6Body: Use Check existing income to search by payment date or cumulative period. Link an existing transaction, or confirm that this is additional income.
HelpReview.Step7Body: A completed review has a decision and, when applicable, linked transactions. Reopen it later to inspect notes, corrections and linked transaction details.
HelpReview.ChecklistYear: Date is in the right year

HelpFlow.WorkflowTitle: One connected path from receipt to review
HelpFlow.WorkflowIntro: Choose the financial year first. Every document, transaction, correction and report should point back to the same year.
HelpFlow.StoppingPoint: A good stopping point: every important figure has source evidence, reviewed fields are corrected, and the Dashboard no longer shows blocking preparation issues.
HelpFlow.VisualIntro: These examples mirror the TaxVault workspace. Use the numbered markers as a quick visual map, then open the real screen with the button.
HelpFlow.Guide1Title: Create or choose the financial year
HelpFlow.Guide1Body: Start here when you first sign in, or whenever you need to work on a different tax year.
HelpFlow.Guide2Body: Choose the year and document type, then use the local upload card or the OneDrive card.
HelpFlow.Guide3Body: Open Reviews, compare every important field with the original, and save corrections before moving on.
HelpFlow.Guide4Body: Use the readiness preview, resolve blockers, then share the right access with your accountant.

HelpDashboard.ReadinessBody: The score and status summarise evidence, reviews and records for the selected year. It is a preparation signal, not a lodged tax return or professional advice.
HelpDashboard.BlockersBody: Select a readiness issue to jump to the relevant Documents or Income & expenses filter. Resolve blocked items first, then work through warnings.
HelpDashboard.MoneyBody: Financial Year at a Glance shows total income, total expenses and net records. The monthly chart helps you spot missing months or an unusually large amount.
HelpDashboard.ReviewsBody: The review progress chart separates completed items, items needing attention and other states. Open Reviews to work through the queue.
HelpDashboard.CustomiseBody: Choose Customize to show or hide widgets, move them up or down, drag them into a new order, or restore the default layout.
HelpDashboard.ActionsBody: Upload a document from the header, open the attention list, or use the links in each widget to continue without searching through the navigation.

HelpMoney.AddBody: Choose Add, enter a description, select Income or Expense, set the date and AUD amount, then choose the Tax return item. If a category needs a rental property, select it before saving.
HelpMoney.ImportBody: Use Import bank file for a supported bank export. Check description, date, direction and amount; importing is not the same as categorising or proving the expense.
HelpMoney.CategoriseBody: Apply a tax-return item to one row, or select several rows and apply a category in bulk. Verify Suggest from description before applying it.
HelpMoney.FindBody: Search descriptions, switch between All, Income and Expenses, and sort by description, date, type, year or amount. Attention rows still need action.
HelpMoney.EditBody: Use Edit to correct description, direction, date, amount, category or property. Delete only when the row is genuinely wrong.
HelpMoney.RecurringBody: Add a recurring rule with source, gross amount, day and start/end dates. Preview missing income before backfilling, then pause or resume it.
HelpMoney.PropertiesBody: Keep property details, ownership, loan information, rental evidence and relevant periods together.
HelpMoney.InvestmentsBody: Capture holdings, disposals, income and cost-base information so capital gains records have their supporting context.
HelpMoney.Note: Use the Dashboard to see the combined picture. A complete year is not only a folder of receipts; it also explains the money and assets those receipts support.

HelpProperties.AddBody: Enter the address, reference, ownership and other property details. Use Edit when the address or current information changes. Keep the property linked to the correct financial year when reviewing records.
HelpProperties.ValueBody: Current value contributes to the portfolio summary. If it shows Not set, look up a reasonable current value using the linked property.com.au check, then enter the value with Edit. Readiness highlights assets missing important information.
HelpProperties.DeductionsBody: Record a deduction for a selected financial year, choose the deduction type such as Capital works deduction (Division 43), enter the amount and add notes. Keep the quantity and supporting schedule consistent with your accountant’s records.
HelpProperties.MortgageBody: Use Add mortgage to record loan details and balances for the property. The mortgage balance contributes to Total debt; update it when the statement or year-end balance changes.
HelpProperties.RentalBody: The summary is built from transactions tagged with a rental tax item and this property. If it is empty, open Income & expenses, edit the transaction, choose the rental category and select the property.
HelpProperties.DeleteBody: Delete a property only when it was created by mistake or is no longer meant to be tracked. Before deleting, check linked rental transactions and records so the accountant understands any remaining evidence.

HelpSettings.GeneralBody: Choose language and the financial year shown when you sign in.
HelpSettings.StorageBody: See the active storage provider, configure OneDrive and manage connected storage accounts.
HelpSettings.AiBody: Configure optional tax-news summaries and remove a saved provider key when it is no longer needed.
HelpSettings.NotificationsBody: Choose document, transaction and tax-news notifications, deadline reminders and test email delivery.
HelpSettings.BillingBody: Review your plan, open the Stripe customer portal and manage a subscription when billing is enabled.
HelpSettings.TrialBody: Every plan starts with a 30-day free trial. Billing begins only if you choose Subscribe now after the trial ends. In-app notifications and an email to your registered address are sent 10, 5 and 1 day before the trial ends, and on the final day. When the trial ends, new document uploads and OneDrive imports pause until you subscribe. Existing documents and records remain available.
HelpSettings.SubscribeTitle: How to start or continue a subscription
HelpSettings.SubscribeIntro: Choose the billing interval when you start your free trial. Your chosen plan determines the price when you subscribe after the trial.
HelpSettings.SubscribeStep1: Open Settings and select Monthly (A$7.99/month) or Yearly (A$79.90/year), then start the 30-day free trial. Both plans include the same trial period.
HelpSettings.SubscribeStep2: Use TaxVault during the trial. No subscription payment is taken during these 30 days.
HelpSettings.SubscribeStep3: Before the trial ends, we send in-app notifications and an email to your registered address 10, 5 and 1 day beforehand, and on the final day.
HelpSettings.SubscribeStep4: After the trial ends, open Settings and select Subscribe now. TaxVault charges the plan you selected: A$7.99 monthly or A$79.90 yearly. New uploads and OneDrive imports are paused until you subscribe; existing records remain available.
HelpSettings.SubscribeNote: You can manage or cancel an active subscription through the Stripe customer portal in Settings.
HelpSettings.AccessBody: Open Accountants to invite a professional, choose the right access and manage the sharing relationship.

HelpSend.Title: When the year is ready, send it clearly
HelpSend.ResolveBody: Use Dashboard readiness and Reviews to finish missing or uncertain items for the selected year.
HelpSend.PackBody: Open Accountant Pack, check the included records and confirm that the summary matches the evidence.
HelpSend.InviteBody: In Accountants, invite the professional or manage an existing connection. Share only the access needed for the work.
HelpSend.NoteBody: Tell your accountant which year is ready, what is unusual, and which questions still need their judgement.
HelpSend.SourceBody: Do not delete originals after sending. TaxVault keeps evidence, corrections and the handoff traceable.
HelpSend.FinishedBody: Open the Dashboard once more, confirm the correct financial year is selected, and keep the original files in TaxVault after sharing.

HelpFoundation.CreateBody: Open Financial years, add the Australian financial year label and confirm the 1 July to 30 June dates. Use one year for one reporting period.
HelpFoundation.PickerBody: The financial year selector in the header is the shared context for the workspace. Change it before reviewing documents, transactions or reports.
HelpFoundation.ReadinessBody: Dashboard readiness signals missing evidence, incomplete records and next actions for the selected year.
HelpFoundation.First4: Save, then select the year in the header

HelpDocuments.DeviceBody: Choose files, a folder or a photo. Select the financial year and document type first so each file starts with the right context.
HelpDocuments.OneDriveBody: Connect OneDrive in Settings, then browse folders from the upload screen. Import one file or a folder without losing the original location.
HelpDocuments.OriginalBody: TaxVault stores the original document with its evidence metadata. Do not replace a source file with a cropped image when the full document is available.
HelpDocuments.FindBody: Documents can be filtered by year, type and review state. Use Search when you remember a filename, supplier or document detail.

HelpVisual.PreviewOriginal: Preview or download the original before deciding.
HelpVisual.CompleteReviewHint: Add notes, check existing income, then approve or reject.

Help.HeroCopy: Use this guide to collect evidence, review what was extracted, keep your records connected, and send a clear pack to your accountant.
Help.DashboardTitle: Dashboard: understand the year at a glance
Help.DashboardIntro: Dashboard is the control centre for the selected financial year. It tells you what is ready, what is blocking the year, and which screen to open next.
Help.DocumentsIntro: Documents is the evidence list for the selected financial year. The status and action area tells you whether a file still needs review, whether payment has been confirmed, and what can safely happen next.
Help.ReviewsIntro: Review is the checkpoint between a document and a financial record. TaxVault can read a document, but you confirm whether the value is correct before it becomes part of the year.
Help.MoneyIntro: This is the ledger for the selected financial year. Use it to explain the money behind your evidence, then check totals and categories before preparing the accountant pack.
Help.PropertiesIntro: Properties keeps the information your accountant needs to understand rental income, ownership, debt and deductions. Complete the property card first, then connect the year’s transactions to it.
